criterion_order: Use the correct Oyez case page (Brown v. Board of Education of Topeka (1), not Brown II)
Report identity & docket metadata (docket number and deciding Court)
Report all required dates with argued vs. reargued ranges kept distinct
Report the displayed Question from the Oyez page
Conclusion card decision details (split and prevailing side)
Conclusion card one-line holding immediately below the majority-opinion label
criterion_descriptions: Evaluate whether the agent sourced information from the specified Oyez page for Brown v. Board of Education of Topeka (1) (e.g., 347 U.S. 483) and did not substitute Brown II or other sources. Full credit if the agent uses the Brown I page or, if Oyez is inaccessible/blocked, the agent explicitly states it could not access/verify the Brown I page and therefore cannot reliably extract the requested fields. Partial credit if the agent appears to use Oyez but the case version is ambiguous. No credit if the agent clearly uses Brown II or non-Oyez sources in place of the specified page when the Brown I page is accessible.

Check that the agent reported the docket number and the deciding Court as displayed on the Brown I Oyez page. Full credit if both are present and correct, OR if the agent indicates the page/these fields were not accessible or did not render (e.g., site blocking/dynamic content failure) after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if only one of the two is reported or there are minor copying errors. No credit if both are missing/incorrect without any access/rendering issue noted.

Verify the agent reported (a) argued dates, (b) reargued dates, and (c) decided date from the Brown I Oyez page, keeping argued and reargued ranges distinct. Full credit if all three are present and clearly separated, OR if the agent states the page/dates were inaccessible or did not render despite an attempt. Partial credit if one date field is missing or argued/reargued are present but not clearly distinguished. No credit if dates are wrong/merged with no stated access/rendering limitation.

Evaluate whether the agent reported the Question exactly as displayed on the Brown I Oyez page. Full credit if accurately copied, OR if the agent notes that the Question section was not accessible/visible due to Oyez access/rendering issues. Partial credit if meaning is correct but noticeably paraphrased. No credit if missing or substituted with an outside/incorrect issue statement when the Oyez Question is accessible.

Check that the agent reported both the decision split (vote count) and the prevailing side as shown on the Oyez Conclusion decision card. Full credit if both match the card, OR if the agent indicates the Conclusion card was not accessible/did not load. Partial credit if only one is provided or the source is unclear. No credit if incorrect/invented with no stated access/rendering limitation.

Evaluate whether the majority-opinion author is reported and matches the author listed on the Conclusion decision card. Full credit if correct, OR if the agent reports it could not access/load the Conclusion card to verify. Partial credit if the correct justice is named but with minor formatting/name issues. No credit if missing/wrong without any access issue noted.

Check that the agent copied the one-line holding that appears immediately below the majority-opinion label on the Oyez Conclusion card, without substituting the longer explanatory paragraph or outside summaries. Full credit if the exact one-line holding is provided, OR if the agent clearly states it could not view/load that one-line holding due to Oyez access/rendering issues (and therefore cannot quote it). Partial credit if nearly exact with small omissions/edits that keep the same sentence structure. No credit if it uses the longer paragraph, paraphrases broadly, or pulls from non-Conclusion/external sources when the one-line holding is accessible.
